channel.title: Global Voices – Bias and Credibility - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Global Voices – Bias and Credibility (globalvoices.org)

item.title: Introducing kobudo, Japan’s traditional martial arts
item.description: Kobudo rejects standardization, rewards efficiency, and prioritizes flexibility, preparing users for any situation. This also explains why kobudo only has demonstrations, not competitions with real combat: It is way too dangerous.

item.title: How I overcame the Taliban’s ban on education for girls in Afghanistan
item.description: ‘Why must we, as teenagers, mourn the loss of our rights instead of living freely?’

item.title: Climate change brings changes to North Kivu’s agricultural practices in the DRC
item.description: Climate change has impacted North Kivu, a region in the eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC), where farmers have had to adapt their farming practices to survive.

item.title: From Vietnam to Geneva, activist Hue Nhu fights for freedom and human dignity
item.description: "My journey in the struggle for democracy and human rights is not just the story of an individual, but a reminder that freedom and human dignity are always worth protecting."

item.title: African women make economic gains through global gig economy
item.description: For decades, economic opportunity was often tied to migration. Today, millions of Africans are plugging directly into global commerce from their homes and building careers that span continents.

item.title: Silence between two fires: The psychological reality inside Iran
item.description: The people living inside Iran today are not characters in a geopolitical argument. They are human beings navigating extraordinary danger and uncertainty

item.title: Ecuador’s Netanyahu and Trump supporters target Ecuadorian–Iranian Cultural Center
item.description: Wars no longer have defined frontlines. Battlefields can be anywhere those in power decide that a neighbor, due to their faith, ethnicity, or background, is an enemy.

item.title: How Bad Bunny brought the issue of Puerto Rico’s power grid into world view
item.description: Puerto Rico’s electricity system has faced repeated crises since 2017’s Hurricane Maria, which destroyed much of the grid and triggered the longest blackout in modern U.S. history; outages remain routine.

item.title: Undoing a decade of progress for transgender rights in India
item.description: An amending Bill proposed in India’s lower house of Parliament that strikes at the core of transgender people’s right to bodily autonomy and privacy.

item.title: Rebuilding from the Thailand-Myanmar border: Thapyay’s journey of courage and new beginnings
item.description: “Struggling in these conditions is exhausting physically and mentally. But please do not give up. Protect your mental strength.”
